Balanced.label: Balanced
Balanced.description: Equally distributes optimization weight across comfort, economic cost efficiency, structural safety, and sustainability.

Low cost.label: Low Cost
Low cost.description: Maximizes financial affordability by heavily weighting low-cost vernacular and standardized construction methods.

Safety first.label: Safety First
Safety first.description: Focuses on structural robustness, high impact resistance, and durability against extreme weather risks.

Eco friendly.label: Eco Friendly
Eco friendly.description: Prioritizes minimal embodied carbon, circular renewable materials, and low-impact ecological building strategies.
